q1.question: Does it work on job sites like LinkedIn, Indeed, Greenhouse?

q2.question: Is my profile data private?

q3.question: What is Gemini Nano?

q4.question: Do I need an API key?

page.title: Null Carrier — Deep-Space Signal Puzzle Game | Steam
page.description: Operate a deep-space listening array. Tune frequencies, reconstruct signals, question your orders. A minimalist atmospheric puzzle game coming to Steam.
page.ogTitle: Null Carrier — Deep-Space Signal Puzzle Game | Steam
page.ogDescription: Operate a deep-space listening array. Tune frequencies, reconstruct signals, question your orders. A minimalist atmospheric puzzle game coming to Steam.

hero.title:
Signal received.
Source unknown.
hero.subtitle: You work the deep-space listening array. Tune the frequencies. Reconstruct the transmissions. Classify for Command. Don't ask questions.

section1.title: One screen. Infinite doubt.
section1.paragraph1: Every shift begins the same way. A signal arrives. You tune your carrier frequency and noise gate until the waveform clears. You reconstruct the transmission — a pixel pattern that might mean something. You classify it and send it to Command.
section1.paragraph3: At shift 12, something is slightly off. At shift 23, you notice the coordinates don't add up. By shift 40, you've stopped trusting the readouts entirely.

card1.title: Tune to Receive
card1.description: Adjust carrier frequency and noise gate sliders. Find the lock zone where clarity peaks. The signal is there — you just have to find it.

card2.title: Reconstruct the Pattern
card2.description: A pixel matrix emerges from noise as your tuning improves. Each cell locks in when clarity is high enough.

card3.title: Classify for Command
card3.description: Submit your reconstruction. Command responds. Cryptically. You won't know if you were right. That's the point.

card4.title: Read Between the Shifts
card4.description: No tutorial. No objectives. Just metadata, coordinates, timestamps, and patterns. The story is only there if you look for it.

philosophy.sectionTitle: Built to feel like a real instrument.
philosophy.subtitle: No 3D. No cutscenes. No dialogue. The entire game is played on one screen that looks and feels like actual signal analysis hardware. Every visual element earns its place.
philosophy.tagline: Radical minimalism · Industrial UI · Systems-driven narrative

q1.question: The extension button isn't appearing on a form
q1.answer: Some websites use JavaScript to render forms dynamically. Try scrolling down to trigger the page to fully load, then look for the ⚡ button. If it still doesn't appear, email us with the URL of the site.

q2.question: Gemini Nano says "Not supported on this device"
q2.answer: Gemini Nano requires Chrome 127+ and sufficient device RAM (typically 8GB+). You can still use the extension by adding your own API key in Settings (Bring Your Own Key). OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, and OpenRouter are all supported.

q3.question: My profile isn't saving
q3.answer: Go to the extension's Options page (right-click extension icon → Options). Make sure you've clicked Save after entering your profile. If it still doesn't save, try the Troubleshoot button on the Options page.

q4.question: The AI-generated answer doesn't sound like me
q4.answer: The AI uses your profile to generate answers. Fill in the Bio and Experience fields with detail — the more context you give it, the better the output. You can always edit any answer before submitting.

q5.question: How do I uninstall and remove my data?
q5.answer: In Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, find Donbrico Autofill AI, click Remove. All your profile data will be deleted automatically.

q6.question: How do I report a bug or request a feature?
q6.answer: Email support@donbrico.net with "Bug:" or "Feature Request:" at the start of your subject line.

nullCarrier.paragraph: For issues with Null Carrier on Steam, you can reach us through Steam's support system or directly at support@donbrico.net.
nullCarrier.steamNote: Please include your Steam username and a description of the issue.

responseTime.paragraph: Donbrico is a solo development operation. Support is provided on a best-effort basis. We aim to respond within 1–2 business days. Critical extension bugs are prioritized.

q1.question: The extension toolbar isn't appearing on a page
q1.answer: Make sure you're on a page with a text field (input or textarea). Click inside the field first — the AI Reply toolbar should appear near the field. If it doesn't, refresh the page and try again.

q2.question: My saved replies aren't showing up
q2.answer: Check that you've saved replies in the Library tab of the extension popup. If you recently re-installed, replies stored locally are gone unless you exported a backup (Pro feature).

q3.question: Gemini Nano says 'Not supported on this device'
q3.answer: Gemini Nano requires Chrome 127+ with sufficient RAM (typically 8GB+). You can still use the extension by adding your own API key in Settings (Bring Your Own Key). Supported providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, OpenRouter.

q4.question: AI-generated replies sound generic or off-topic
q4.answer: The AI uses the text field's context plus your selected tone. For best results, use specific prompts and set a detailed tone. If using a BYOK provider, try switching to a different model.

q5.question: How do I uninstall and remove my data?
q5.answer: In Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, find Donbrico AI Reply Assistant, click Remove. This deletes all locally stored replies and settings.

q6.question: How do I report a bug or request a feature?
q6.answer: Email support@donbrico.net with 'Bug:' or 'Feature Request:' at the start of your subject line.

q1.question: How do I save a workspace?
q1.answer: Click the extension icon to open the popup, then click 'Save Current window' or 'Save All Windows'. AI will suggest a name, or you can type your own.

q2.question: Can I restore workspaces on another computer?
q2.answer: Yes, if you use the 'Export as JSON' feature (Pro) to backup your data and import it on your other device.

q3.question: What happens if I delete a workspace?
q3.answer: Deleted workspaces are gone forever. However, you can use the 'Archive' feature to hide workspaces without deleting them.

page.title: Privacy Policy — Donbrico
page.description: Privacy Policy for donbrico.net, Donbrico Autofill AI, AI Reply Assistant Chrome extensions, and Null Carrier.
page.ogDescription: Privacy Policy for donbrico.net, Donbrico Autofill AI, AI Reply Assistant Chrome extensions, and Null Carrier.

hero.subtitle: How we handle your data across all Donbrico products.

overview.paragraph: Donbrico is committed to protecting your privacy. All Donbrico Chrome extensions store data locally on your device. This website does not use analytics, cookies, or any tracking scripts.

whatWeCollect.paragraph: None. All profile data is stored locally in Chrome's storage on the user's device. No data is transmitted to any server owned or operated by Donbrico.

howStored.paragraph: Chrome's storage.local API, never chrome.storage.sync for sensitive data. Data remains on the device and is never uploaded.

thirdPartyAI.sectionTitle: Third-party AI providers (Bring Your Own Key)
thirdPartyAI.paragraph: If the user configures a Bring Your Own Key provider such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, or OpenRouter, their form context and relevant profile data is sent to that third-party provider. Donbrico is not responsible for the privacy practices of those providers. Gemini Nano (the default AI) runs entirely on-device.

permissions.paragraph: storage (local profile), activeTab (detect forms on current tab), scripting (inject autofill button), host_permissions (work on any website the user visits).

dataDeletion.paragraph: Uninstalling the extension removes all stored data.

game.paragraph: The game itself does not collect personal data. Steam's own privacy policy governs any data collected through the Steam platform.

website.paragraph: No analytics, no cookies, no tracking scripts. The website is a static HTML site hosted on Cloudflare Pages. No forms, no user accounts, no data collection of any kind.

changes.paragraph: This policy may be updated. Check this page for the latest version.

aiReplyAssistant.sectionTitle: Donbrico AI Reply Assistant — Chrome Extension

whatWeCollect.paragraph: None. All saved replies and settings are stored locally in Chrome's storage on your device. No data is transmitted to Donbrico servers.

howStored.paragraph: Saved replies and templates are stored in Chrome's local storage. If you enable Chrome sync, this data may be synced across your devices via Google's servers — that sync is controlled by Chrome, not by this extension.

thirdPartyAI.sectionTitle: Third-party AI providers (Bring Your Own Key)
thirdPartyAI.paragraph: When you use the AI reply generation feature, the text context (the field you're replying to), your selected tone, and any prompt or template variables are sent to your configured AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, or OpenRouter). If you use Gemini Nano (the default), all AI processing occurs on-device and nothing leaves your browser. Donbrico does not store, log, or process any AI requests.

permissions.paragraph: storage (for saved replies and settings), activeTab (to detect text fields), scripting (to inject the reply toolbar), host_permissions (to work on any website you visit).

dataDeletion.paragraph: Uninstalling the extension deletes all locally stored replies, templates, and settings. No data is retained on Donbrico servers.

whatWeCollect.paragraph: None. Your workspace names, tab URLs, and window arrangements are stored locally in Chrome's storage on your device. No data is transmitted to Donbrico servers.

howStored.paragraph: All workspace data is stored in Chrome's local storage. This data never leaves your device unless you manually export it.

thirdPartyAI.sectionTitle: Third-party AI providers (Bring Your Own Key)
thirdPartyAI.paragraph: When using AI features (naming, cleanup, search), tab titles and URLs may be sent to your configured AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.). If you use Gemini Nano, all processing is on-device. Donbrico does not store or log any AI requests.

permissions.paragraph: storage (for workspaces), tabs (to save/restore sessions), windows (to manage multiple windows), notifications (for save reminders).

dataDeletion.paragraph: Uninstalling the extension deletes all locally stored workspaces and settings. No data is retained on Donbrico servers.

page.title: API Keys Guide — Donbrico Autofill AI

header.title: Get your API Keys
header.intro: Donbrico Autofill AI works best when you connect your own AI provider. Here is how to get your keys from the most popular services.

speedNote.title: Blazing fast.
speedNote.text: Using your own API key is typically 5-10x faster than the built-in free models and has much higher limits.

groq.title: Groq
groq.label: Provider 01
groq.intro: Groq runs open-source models on custom silicon (LPUs) — the result is remarkably fast inference. The free tier is generous enough for everyday autofill use at no cost.

step1.title: Sign up for a free Groq account
step1.text: Go to console.groq.com and click Sign up. Groq supports Google, GitHub, and email signup. No credit card is required for the free tier.

step2.title: Create an API key
step2.text: In the left sidebar, click API Keys. Click Create API Key, enter a name like "Donbrico", and click Submit.
step2.warn: Copy the key immediately. Groq does not show it again after creation. It begins with gsk_…

step3.title: Paste into the extension
step3.text: Open the extension popup → Settings → AI Provider → Groq. Paste your key and save.

groq.info: Groq free tier includes rate limits (e.g. 30 requests/minute for Llama 3). For typical autofill usage this is more than enough. If you hit limits, upgrading to a paid plan removes them.

openrouter.title: OpenRouter
openrouter.label: Provider 02
openrouter.intro: OpenRouter is a unified gateway to over 100 AI models — including GPT-4o, Claude, Llama, Mistral, and many more — through a single API key. Several models are permanently free with no credit card required.

step1.title: Create an OpenRouter account
step1.text: Visit openrouter.ai and click Sign In. OpenRouter supports Google and GitHub sign-in, or you can use an email address.

step2.title: Optional: add credits for paid models
step2.text: Go to Credits in your account and top up if you want to use paid models like GPT-4o or Claude. For free models only, no payment is needed.
step2.tip: Filter by Free on the Models page to see the full list of zero-cost models available right now.

step3.title: Create an API key
step3.text: Go to Keys in the top navigation. Click Create Key, name it "Donbrico", and copy the key — it begins with sk-or-…
step3.warn: Copy the key now — it will be hidden after you close this dialog.

step4.title: Paste into the extension
step4.text: Open the extension popup → Settings → AI Provider → OpenRouter. Paste your key, choose your preferred model, and save.

anthropic.title: Anthropic
anthropic.label: Provider 03
anthropic.intro: Anthropic's Claude models are known for following instructions precisely — ideal for generating well-structured cover letters and professional answers.

step1.title: Create an Anthropic account
step1.text: Visit console.anthropic.com and click Sign up. You can use Google or an email address.

step2.title: Add billing information
step2.text: From the Console dashboard, go to Settings → Billing. Click Add credit card and complete the form. Anthropic is pay-as-you-go with no monthly fee.
step2.tip: You can set a monthly spend limit under Billing → Usage limits to avoid any surprise charges.

step3.title: Generate an API key
step3.text: In the left sidebar, click API Keys. Click Create Key, name it "Donbrico", and copy the key — it starts with sk-ant-…
step3.warn: The key is shown only once at creation time. Copy it before closing the dialog.

step4.title: Paste into the extension
step4.text: Open the extension popup → Settings → AI Provider → Anthropic. Paste your key and save.

openai.title: OpenAI
openai.label: Provider 04
openai.intro: OpenAI is the most widely used provider. GPT-4o mini is fast, accurate, and costs fractions of a cent per autofill.

step1.title: Create a free account
step1.text: Go to platform.openai.com and sign up. You can use Google, Microsoft, or email.

step2.title: Add a payment method
step2.text: Navigate to Settings → Billing → Add payment method. OpenAI requires a credit card before generating API keys. You will only be charged for actual usage — new accounts receive $5 in free credits.

step3.title: Create an API key
step3.text: Go to API Keys in the left sidebar (or visit platform.openai.com/api-keys). Click Create new secret key, give it a name like "Donbrico", and click Create secret key.
step3.warn: Copy your key immediately — OpenAI only shows it once. Store it somewhere safe.

step4.title: Paste the key into the extension
step4.text: Open the Donbrico Autofill AI popup → Settings → AI Provider → OpenAI. Paste your key (it starts with sk-…) and click Save.

proTip.label: Pro tip
proTip.text: No API key needed at all — if your computer supports it, Gemini Nano runs directly in Chrome for free with complete privacy.

page.title: Gemini Nano Setup — Donbrico Autofill AI

header.title:
Using Gemini Nano
in Chrome
header.intro: Gemini Nano is built directly into Chrome on supported hardware. When it works, your AI completions run entirely on your device — free, instant, and never leaving your machine.

note.title: Note:
note.text: Gemini Nano runs on your device, so it can be slower than cloud-based AI providers. For faster responses, consider using a Bring Your Own Key provider like Groq (free tier available) or OpenAI.

toc.title: On this page
toc.enable: Enable Gemini Nano in Chrome flags
toc.fallback: What happens if it doesn't work?

requirements.title: System requirements
requirements.intro: Gemini Nano runs locally, so your hardware matters. Chrome checks these requirements automatically before enabling the model.

browser.label: Browser
browser.note: Desktop only. Not available on mobile Chrome or other browsers.

os.label: Operating System
os.note: ChromeOS also supported on newer Chromebooks.

storage.label: Available Storage
storage.note: Chrome downloads the Nano model (~20 GB) on first use.

gpu.label: GPU / NPU
gpu.note: Integrated graphics usually work, but a dedicated GPU speeds inference significantly.

requirements.info: If your machine doesn't meet these requirements, Donbrico Autofill AI will automatically fall back to your configured API key — no action needed on your part.

enable.title: Enable Gemini Nano in Chrome
enable.intro: Gemini Nano and the Prompt API are experimental features. You need to enable two Chrome flags and then download the model before it will respond to requests.

step1.title: Open Chrome flags
step1.text: Type the following into your Chrome address bar and press Enter:

step2.title: Enable the Prompt API flag
step2.text: Search for Prompt API for Gemini Nano in the flags search box, then set it to Enabled.
step2.desc: Enables the window.ai JavaScript API so extensions can interact with Gemini Nano.

step3.title: Enable Optimization Guide (model download)
step3.text: Search for Enables optimization guide on device and set it to Enabled BypassPerfRequirement. The bypass option allows download even on lower-spec hardware.
step3.desc: Allows Chrome to download the Gemini Nano model to your device.

step4.title: Relaunch Chrome
step4.text: Click the blue Relaunch button that appears at the bottom of the flags page, or close and reopen Chrome completely.

step5.title: Trigger the model download
step5.text: After relaunching, navigate to the components page to force Chrome to download the Nano model:
step5.text2: Find Optimization Guide On Device Model in the list and click Check for update. The download may take several minutes depending on your connection. The model is approximately 20 GB.

enable.warn: The model download happens silently in the background. Chrome must be open and connected to the internet. Once downloaded, it stays on your device permanently.

verify.title: Verify it's working
verify.intro: Once the model is downloaded, you can confirm everything is set up correctly without leaving Chrome.

devtools.title: Quick test via DevTools
devtools.text: Open any webpage, press F12 (or right-click → Inspect → Console), and paste this snippet:

results.title: The console output means:
results.readily: "readily" — Gemini Nano is downloaded and ready. You're all set.
results.afterDownload: "after-download" — Chrome knows about the model but it's still downloading. Wait and try again in a few minutes.
results.no: "no" — The model isn't available on this device. Check the troubleshooting section below.

verify.tip: Once you see "readily", open the Donbrico Autofill AI extension popup. The AI status indicator in settings should show Gemini Nano · Active.

console.title: The console returns "no" or throws an error
console.text: Go back through the steps above and confirm both flags are enabled (not just one). Then relaunch Chrome again and wait 5–10 minutes before retesting. Chrome sometimes delays initialising the API even after the flags are set.

components.title: chrome://components shows no version for the model
components.text: Make sure you're signed into Chrome with a Google account. In some regions, the model is gated behind a Google account sign-in. Also ensure Chrome is not running through a VPN or proxy that blocks Google's download servers.

stuck.title: The model download is stuck
stuck.text: Visit chrome://components, find the Optimization Guide model, and click Check for update again. If it remains stuck, try restarting Chrome and checking for updates once more.

requirements.title: My machine meets requirements but it still shows "no"
requirements.list1: Confirm you're on Chrome version 127 or later (check chrome://version).
requirements.list2: Some enterprise-managed Chrome installs block experimental flags. Check with your IT team.
requirements.list3: Ensure Chrome has at least 22 GB of free disk space to store the model.
requirements.list4: Try disabling and re-enabling both flags, then relaunching.

fallback.title: What happens if it doesn't work?
fallback.text1: Donbrico Autofill AI gracefully falls back to your Bring Your Own Key API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, or OpenRouter) whenever Gemini Nano isn't available. You'll never be left without AI completions.
fallback.text2: If neither Gemini Nano nor an API key is configured, the extension will show a friendly prompt guiding you to set one up. You can always add an API key in the extension's settings panel.
fallback.tip: Need an API key? See the API Keys guide to get one from OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, or OpenRouter in under 5 minutes.
